picks.title: Read the charter for the White House's 'Super Intelligence Force'
picks.excerpt: POLITICO publishes the charter of the White House 'Super Intelligence Force' — a new body with broad authority to determine how the federal government should protect against AI threats. New primary document following the Super Intelligence executive order and Jay Clayton's appointment.
picks.rationale: Primary document: the charter that defines the new federal AI-threat body's authority, a concrete official release beyond the earlier EO and czar appointment.

picks.title: 미 국방부, 앤트로픽 AI 사용 중단…블랙리스트 지정 8개월만
picks.excerpt: 미국 국방부가 앤트로픽의 클로드 모델 등 AI 제품 사용을 중단했다고 발표 — 공급망 위험(블랙리스트) 지정 8개월 만. US Pentagon says it has stopped using Anthropic's Claude products.
picks.rationale: New official action in AI procurement: the Pentagon announced it has stopped using Claude, directly affecting vendors selling AI to government.

picks.title: Jailed Albanian mayor uses AI avatar to make deepfake speech
picks.excerpt: Tirana's jailed mayor Erion Veliaj is using an AI avatar to deliver a deepfake speech and keep running the city from behind bars, raising questions about synthetic media in politics.
picks.rationale: Novel case of an officeholder using a synthetic avatar for political communication; the story only exists because of AI.

picks.title: 日출판협회 "중고책 美 AI 학습용으로 대량판매 의혹…허용안돼"
picks.excerpt: 일본출판협회, 도서 유통업체가 미국 AI 개발사에 AI 학습용으로 중고책을 대량 판매했다는 의혹에 '허용 안 돼' 성명 — AI 학습 저작권 쟁점.
picks.rationale: Formal statement from Japan's publishers' association objecting to bulk used-book sales for US AI training; a new cross-border AI-training copyright dispute with no story without AI.

picks.title: Latino group bets on bilingual AI to cut voter confusion before the midterms
picks.excerpt: A national Latino civic engagement group is turning to a bilingual AI app to help voters navigate an increasingly complicated election system ahead of the midterms.
picks.rationale: New deployment of an AI voter-information tool ahead of the midterms; a non-partisan look at AI in election administration rather than deepfake risk.

https://www.politico.eu/article/document.new_action: Charter of the White House 'Super Intelligence Force' published (new primary document defining the body's authority), distinct from the 9/30 EO and the 10/05 Clayton appointment.
